metanarrative_source: Canonical SLOP_METANARRATIV_R1.md reread from docs/kfb-decisions-register-2026-10-11; new biographies remain DESIGN, calls are proposals and not canonical Triplet excerpts

records.name: Mina Manyhandles
records.biography_en: Every awkward HyperNorm card gets a jar; the Men in Black have requested more handles.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The container can be carried by a committee.

records.name: Theo Almostbull
records.biography_en: Hunky and Dory schedule his bravery between two public demonstrations of certainty.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: He has negotiated a smaller rehearsal bull.

records.name: Bram Bluecurl
records.biography_en: He paints over unwanted cards and keeps finding the covered stories in his sea creatures.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The octopus has submitted a ninth revision.

records.name: Dorian Softbronze
records.biography_en: He guards a HyperNorm doorway that reconstruction moves every morning.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The post is permanent. Its location is seasonal.

records.name: Faye Frescowet
records.biography_en: She makes each restored facade more reassuring, then leaves one unsettling blue wave.

records.name: Niko Tiedcargo
records.biography_en: The Men in Black call his sealed cargo normality; he calls it heavy.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Fragile is the heaviest shipping class.
